    if not c:

    cycle = c['cycle']
    phase = step_count % (2 * cycle)
    overlap = c.get('overlap', 10)
    speed = c.get('speed', 2.0)
    torque = c.get('torque', 100.0)
    
    if phase < cycle:
        # Use left leg: rotate clockwise to swing towards the wall (x=4.6 -> x=5.0)
        sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][0], True)
        sandbox.set_motor(c['joints'][0], speed, torque)
        # Deactivate right pad during transition to avoid conflicting adhesion
        if phase > overlap:
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][1], False)

            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][1], True)

        sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][1], True)
        sandbox.set_motor(c['joints'][1], -speed, torque)
        # Deactivate left pad during transition
        if (phase - cycle) > overlap:
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][0], False)
        else:
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['pads'][0], True)
